title: LUDIUS: A Benchmark for Embodied Social Intelligence in Everyday Human-Robot Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.34328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social intelligence in a robot requires interpreting a situation from the perspectives of the people involved and using that understanding to decide when and how to act. We introduce LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating how vision-language models exercise this judgment through a robot's verbal responses and actions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science. LUDIUS comprises six editions, each a collection of episodes spanning one simulated week. Three editions each cover all 15 skills in a different household. The other three focus on interactions involving multiple people, safety, and context-specific norms, respectively. We evaluate frontier models and a smaller model finetuned on social-interaction data we generated, using a common evaluation harness. translated_title: LUDIUS：面向日常人机交互中具身社会智能的基准测试
translated_abstract: 机器人要具备社会智能，需要从相关人员的视角来解读情境，并利用这种理解来决定何时以及如何行动。我们提出了LUDIUS，这是一个评估视觉-语言模型如何通过机器人的言语回应和行动来运用这种判断能力的基准，围绕从社会心理学、社会学和认知科学中提炼出的15项社会智能技能组织而成。LUDIUS包含六个版本，每个版本都是跨越一个模拟星期的情景集合。其中三个版本分别在三个不同的家庭中涵盖全部15项技能；另外三个版本则分别聚焦于多人交互、安全以及特定情境下的社会规范。我们使用统一的评估框架对前沿模型以及一个在我们生成的社交互动数据上微调的较小模型进行了评估。该框架为每个模型提供机器人的摄像头视角和居民的反应，并检索相关的交互信息。
tldr: 本文提出LUDIUS基准，围绕源自社会科学的15项社会智能技能，通过跨越模拟一周的六版本人机交互情景，评估视觉-语言模型在家庭日常场景中通过言语回应和行动展现具身社会智能判断的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LUDIUS, a benchmark that evaluates how vision-language models demonstrate embodied social intelligence through a robot's verbal responses and actions in everyday human-robot interactions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science across six editions spanning simulated weeks.
